title: The Water Rising in the Library

breakdown.title: The Water Rising in the Library
breakdown.logline: The dreamer stands in a quiet library as water rises, books float open like birds, their sister arrives in a yellow rowing boat, and a whale swims past before they row to a high round window overlooking a drowned city.

words: the water rising in the library. that's the part that stuck.
yeah, the books started floating off the shelves. tons of them. open like birds.
i was in the water. it kept rising, over the desks and everything.
i don't really remember the feeling. just that it kept coming in and i was watching it.
by the doors, i think. that's where i noticed it coming in under them.
no, it was just me. library was empty and quiet.
there were green glass lamps on the desks. that's all i remember about the light.
the water mattered most, i think. but then my sister showed up in a little yellow rowing boat.
it felt weird but also fine. like she was supposed to be there. she was totally calm.
i don't know where she came from. she was just suddenly there in the boat.
she told me to get in. so i did.
she rowed us between the shelves. and a whale swam past under the water.
saw it clearly. it filled the whole aisle, so big. didn't scare me at all.
just... calm, i guess. peaceful. it was slow.
she didn't react, really. just kept rowing.
to the window. we rowed up to the high round window at the top of the room.
she opened it and outside it was morning. the whole city was underwater. just rooftops and tops of trees.
